description: This file defines the AxisTitleRenderer class, responsible for rendering axis titles (for x and y axes) in a chart within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for calculating layout space and drawing the axis titles with optional rotation and alignment.

classes.name: AxisTitleRenderer
classes.description: Renderer for chart axis titles, supporting layout calculation and drawing with rotation and alignment.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the size and layout parameters for the axis title, considering rotation if specified.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the axis title on the chart, applying rotation and alignment settings.
